description: "Run an evolution checkpoint: recall past outcomes, reflect on the current task, record the lesson."
---

Run the evolution checkpoint the Evolver plugin attached to this prompt.

If no checkpoint is attached, the plugin's beforeSubmitPrompt hook did not run: tell the user that the Evolver plugin's hooks are not active in this Cursor window (Settings → Hooks shows them) and that reloading the window or reinstalling the plugin brings them back.
